changelog:
Initial release — a comprehensive system for presentation planning, design, and delivery.

- Guides users through audience and context analysis before creating slides.
- Provides structured narrative frameworks for different presentation goals.
- Includes detailed slide design templates and rules for clarity and engagement.
- Offers practical advice for impactful openings and closings.
- Emphasizes actionable presentation objectives and success metrics.
- Covers the full lifecycle: planning, design, delivery, and follow-up.
summary: Guide presentations end-to-end: analyze audience, craft compelling narratives, design clear slides, coach delivery, and ensure effective follow-up.
